text: I feel like original anime are much more of a gamble for studios. If it is based on a popular manga or light novel, there is already an audience waiting. With original anime, studios have to sell people on the story from scratch. This sucks because some of the most memorable anime I've watched were originals. I wish studios took more risks with new ideas instead of adapting the same things repeatedly.
